name: Custom Profile Image
description: Upload a custom PNG as your in-game avatar or namecard, bypassing the in-game camera requirement.
author: Stellar

media.caption: The Custom Profile Image window — pick a PNG, follow the on-screen steps, and apply it as your avatar or namecard.

added: Korean (한국어) language support — pick 한국어 under Settings → Themes → Language (needs Stellar 2.21.0).
